{{Top|leg}}
'''Mos Eisley Customs''' was a customs organization working in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In the wake of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] hasty departure from the [[City/Legends|city]], Mos Eisley Customs stepped up the number of inspections it performed.<ref name="VI">{{WEGCite|book=Mos Eisley Adventure Set|story=Vested Interest}}</ref> Mos Eisley Customs also impounded [[Big Bunji/Legends|Big Bunji's]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] when it was discovered to be smuggling [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[espionage matrix]]es.<ref name="TMSBCL">{{WEGCite|book=Mos Eisley Adventure Set|story=There's Many a Slip Betwixt Cup and Lip}}</ref>
